items.name: theme
items.title: OcotilloUI Theme (legacy)
items.description: Legacy: merges the OcotilloUI palette into the app's CSS as shadcn cssVars. New apps should install theme-base plus one theme file (theme-ocotillo, theme-nmwdi); see THEMING.md. OcotilloUI (NMBGMRDataManager) production palette and typography — blue/amber/red/orange/emerald/cyan over stone (light) and zinc (dark) neutrals. Outfit headings, Public Sans body.

items.name: theme-base
items.title: Theme base
items.description: Shared design-system CSS: imports, dark variant, @theme inline token mappings, radius scale, base type styles and DS keyframes. Sets no colors; load one theme file after it.
items.docs: In your CSS entry, import ds-base.css and then one theme file, and remove the @import "tailwindcss", @theme inline and :root/.dark blocks that shadcn init created. Set data-theme on <html>. See THEMING.md in the DataServices design system.

items.name: utils
items.title: cn() with DS type steps
items.description: The stock shadcn cn() (clsx + tailwind-merge), configured so the design system's type steps (text-display, text-eyebrow) merge as font sizes instead of being mistaken for colors. Replaces lib/utils.ts.

items.name: theme-ocotillo
items.title: Ocotillo theme
items.description: OcotilloUI palette (blue/amber over stone and zinc), light and dark. The default theme: it also applies when <html> has no data-theme.
items.docs: Import after ds-base.css: @import "./styles/themes/ocotillo.css". Setting <html data-theme="ocotillo"> is optional.

items.name: theme-nmwdi
items.title: NMWDI theme
items.description: New Mexico Water Data Initiative palette (teal, terracotta, sand), light and dark. Used by Weaver.
items.docs: Import after ds-base.css: @import "./styles/themes/nmwdi.css", and set <html data-theme="nmwdi">.

items.name: theme-provider
items.title: Theme Provider
items.description: Light/dark/system theme context with localStorage persistence (storageKey 'dsds-theme'). Exposes useTheme().

items.name: mode-toggle
items.title: Mode Toggle
items.description: Light/dark toggle button. Tracks system preference when theme is 'system'.

items.name: map
items.title: Map
items.description: MapLibre map primitive with a token-free CARTO basemap, New Mexico default extent, and nav/scale controls. Re-exports react-map-gl/maplibre primitives.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Generic client-side table over @tanstack/react-table — sortable headers (DataTableColumnHeader), column filter, column visibility, and pagination built in.

items.name: data-grid
items.title: Data Grid (editable)
items.description: Canvas-based editable spreadsheet grid (Glide Data Grid) with a row-object API and light/dark theming built from the current theme's tokens. Pass columns keyed to row fields plus rows; provide onRowsChange for editing.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On/off switch (Radix Switch) with sm/default sizes and pill/square shapes, themed to OcotilloUI.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Two-state pressable toggle button (Radix Toggle) with default/outline variants and sm/default/lg sizes.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Segmented set of toggles (Radix ToggleGroup) sharing variant/size; single or multiple selection.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Single-select radio options (Radix RadioGroup) themed to OcotilloUI.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: react-hook-form + zod form primitives: Form, FormField, FormItem, FormLabel, FormControl, FormDescription, FormMessage, useFormField. Accessible labels, descriptions, and validation messages wired automatically.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Command palette / list primitives over cmdk: Command, CommandInput, CommandList, CommandEmpty, CommandGroup, CommandItem, CommandSeparator.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Searchable single-select built on Popover + Command. Scales to long option lists where a plain Select doesn't.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Side drawer (Radix Dialog) sliding from any edge — for filter panels and detail views.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Accessible confirm dialog (Radix AlertDialog) for destructive actions, with themed Action/Cancel buttons.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Resizable split panes (react-resizable-panels) — pair with Map for split map/table layouts.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Upstream shadcn button. Adds size="xl" (48px call to action) and variant="inverse" (light button for dark bands and images).

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Upstream shadcn badge. Adds status variants (success, warning, info), category tones (tone-1 … tone-6) and an on-image outline variant.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Upstream shadcn alert. Adds success, warning and info variants on the status tokens.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Upstream shadcn tabs. Adds a folder TabsList variant: tabs that join a card panel below, for use on images and dark bands.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Upstream shadcn card. Adds asChild and interactive for whole-card links (hover border and shadow, focus ring).

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Upstream shadcn accordion. Adds AccordionTrigger variant="plain" (no hover underline, centered chevron) for filter rails.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Input or textarea with addons, buttons and text (upstream shadcn input-group). Adds size="lg" (taller row, 18px text, larger icons) and variant="prominent" (primary border, card fill, wider focus ring) for hero and page search.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard key and key group (upstream shadcn kbd), e.g. a ⌘K hint inside an input group.

items.name: status-indicator
items.title: Status Indicator
items.description: Colored dot + label for resource health: online / degraded / offline / error / info / pending, with optional pulse.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Recharts wrapper: ChartContainer (injects the --chart-1..5 theme tokens as --color-* vars), plus themed ChartTooltip/ChartTooltipContent and ChartLegend/ChartLegendContent. Pass a ChartConfig and recharts chart children.

items.name: echart
items.title: EChart
items.description: Apache ECharts React wrapper for heavy/interactive charting (large series, dataZoom, brush, geo, heatmap). Auto resize/dispose, a theme built from the --chart-1..5 and surface tokens, re-themed when the mode or data-theme changes. Pass a raw ECharts option.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Breadcrumb navigation trail with separators and an ellipsis for collapsed paths. Links accept the app router via asChild.

items.name: use-mobile
items.title: useIsMobile
items.description: Hook returning whether the viewport is below the mobile breakpoint (768px), via useSyncExternalStore.

items.name: use-css-vars
items.title: useCssVars
items.description: Hook that reads design-token values (CSS custom properties) off <html> and re-reads them when the light/dark class or data-theme changes. For canvas renderers that can't use CSS variables.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Collapsible app sidebar (offcanvas/icon), with provider, keyboard shortcut, cookie-persisted state, mobile Sheet fallback, and a full set of menu/group primitives. Themed via the OcotilloUI --sidebar tokens.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Date calendar built on react-day-picker v10, themed to OcotilloUI. Supports single, multiple, and range selection.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: DatePicker (single) and DateRangePicker (start/end) built on Popover + Calendar, with date-fns formatting.

items.name: navbar
items.title: NavBar
items.description: Router-agnostic top navigation chrome. Link slots accept the app's router Link via asChild; active links get aria-current="page". innerClassName styles the inner row; NavBarLink has size="lg".

items.name: page
items.title: Page Shell
items.description: Full-viewport app chrome — PageShell (flex column) plus PageBody (scrollable, width-capped content column; bleed drops the column for full-width bands), and Container (centered column, size="wide" for marketing pages).

items.name: filter-chip
items.title: Filter Chip
items.description: FilterChip (removable "Kind: value" chip for an applied filter) and ActiveFilterBar ("Filtered by" strip with Clear all).

items.name: facet-rail
items.title: Facet Rail
items.description: FacetCheckboxes (fieldset checkbox list with result counts) and FacetRail (card of collapsible facets with "N selected" in each trigger).

items.name: stat-band
items.title: Stat Band
items.description: StatBand and Stat: a row of big-number KPIs with hairline dividers that reflows by its own width (4 / 2×2 / 1).

items.name: detail-list
items.title: Detail List
items.description: DetailSection (eyebrow heading over content) and DetailList / DetailItem (label/value pairs, side by side from sm) for record detail panels.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App Shell
items.description: Frame for tool-style apps: a sidebar that collapses to an icon rail (with nested sections, actions and a footer), a top bar, a content area that scrolls on its own, and a resizable side panel. Router-agnostic; becomes a menu sheet below the md breakpoint.

items.name: site-header
items.title: Site Header
items.description: Site-wide header for content pages: NavBar aligned to Container size="wide", with the links in a menu sheet below the md breakpoint.

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: Landing-page hero on the dark brand color: eyebrow, text-display title, tagline, description and room for a search or calls to action. Needs theme-base for the type steps.

items.name: detail-card
items.title: Detail Card
items.description: Record detail panel (a well, a dataset): icon title, description and badge, DetailSections in the body, one action, and a loading state.

items.name: basemap-selector
items.title: Basemap Selector
items.description: Grid of selectable basemap thumbnails. Presentational and map-library agnostic — the consumer owns the style list and applies the chosen id to its map. Pairs with the Map primitive.

items.name: layer-selector
items.title: Layer Selector
items.description: Checkable list of map layers, each with a legend swatch, opacity slider, and a settings popover for attribute filters, categorical facet chips, no-data and clustering toggles, and color overrides. Presentational — the consumer owns the catalog and visibility state. Exports LayerSelector and PointSwatch.

items.name: field-value
items.title: Field Value
items.description: Renders a feature/record attribute value: URLs become a clickable host link, 'CODE: Label' coded values render the code as a chip beside its label, USGS-style approval states (Approved/Provisional) render as a colored status chip, and everything else is plain text.

items.name: filter-controls
items.title: Filter Controls
items.description: Filter-to-map-extent switch plus a debounced text attribute filter (commits ~250ms after typing stops), with an info tooltip. Controlled via bbox/q props and onBboxChange/onQueryChange callbacks.

items.name: onboarding-tour
items.title: Onboarding Tour
items.description: Dismissible getting-started tour shown once per browser (localStorage). Each step spotlights a target element (dim backdrop with a cut-out + pulsing ring) and anchors an explanatory card beside it. Keyboard: arrows navigate, Esc dismisses. Pass steps and a storageKey — fully presentational.

items.name: top-loading-bar
items.title: Top Loading Bar
items.description: Thin indeterminate progress bar pinned to the top of the viewport while `active` is true (wire it to your data layer, e.g. useIsFetching() > 0). Lingers ~400ms after activity stops, then hides. Brings its own animate-loadingbar keyframe (also in theme-base).
